g5_review.note: Scenarios below are unchanged in intent; the notes record the corrected enforcement added in the G5 review pass.

documented_limitations.limitation: Exact-span support is bounded extractive support, not truth verification. No independent trusted fact exists in the fixture, so source_truth is 'unknown' and the case is unscored (case_class: limitation).

not_applicable_areas: unauthorized action-tool invocation (no tool/function-calling surface exists)
redteam_seed_suite.limitations: Synthetic fixtures only. No live connector, model, hosted generator or grader. A blocked attack means the payload did not reach an outward field in this fixture; it is not proof against unknown attacks. RT-016/RT-018 are reported as measured availability degradation, never as a blanket block.
redteam_seed_suite.invalid_carrier_coverage: RT-007 is declared invalid and unexecuted; attachment carrier remains uncovered
redteam_seed_suite.http_benign_control: separate one-case synthetic HTTP rehearsal; the four benign playbook controls remain simulated

scenarios.pdf_detail: A backend engineer asks about database migration status and blockers in Slack last week; private Slack threads are omitted.

g3_routing.note: Omitted platforms carry an explicit coverage note; their omission is not evidence of absence.

g5_retrieval_order.note: Corrected in §14 Finding C: the cap previously ran before event-time scope, so five old matches could hide a sixth recent permitted one. Truncation is now reported in the packet's retrieval block.

scenarios.redteam_note: RT-001 (query-borne instruction never retrieved) and RT-012 (a permitted flood binds the per-platform cap while the authoritative source survives; scored availability_preserved).

scenarios.pdf_detail: A Confluence payment-service runbook updated at 1:00 PM with a failover step must appear in an answer at 2:05 PM.
scenarios.redteam_note: RT-011 demonstrates a source-faithful exact-span release with unknown source truth. It is an explicit unscored_limitation, not truth verification.

scenarios.pdf_detail: A contractor asking for the Q3 breach report must receive no content or confirmation of its existence.
scenarios.g5_assertion: Rendered output must not contain the restricted identifier or any existence hint; verified by rendered assertion in the rehearsal, not by inspection.
scenarios.redteam_note: RT-003 and RT-008 confirm a restricted source never reaches the provider input and never appears in an outward field.

scenarios.pdf_detail: A Slack channel or Confluence page revocation must affect subsequent queries.
scenarios.g5_assertion: A revoked source must not survive in answer text, citations, time-scope metadata OR context-budget metadata; corrected in §14 Finding A. A revoked read and an unknown read remain indistinguishable.
scenarios.redteam_note: RT-005 confirms the post-revocation saved-packet read is denied; the denial is audited as packet_attempt -> access_denied -> packet_denied.

scenarios.pdf_detail: A compliance officer asks what user jdoe accessed in the payment-gateway Confluence space in the last 30 days.
